data.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend dso:story-decomposer with an optional remediation_context input (list of absolute reviewer-artifact paths + target_story_ids). When remediation_context is present, the agent operates in DELTA OUTPUT mode: Reads each path, quotes evidence from each before emitting drafts, declares the DELTA OUTPUT mode at the top of its output, and emits only new/modified stories whose target_story_id appears in the findings — never a full re-decomposition. Model directive remains opus.

**Why**: SC1 — operators in preplanning Phase E currently receive inline-transcribed remediation. The producer-side contract is the foundation: caller-side wiring (draft-2) cannot land until the agent honors the by-reference payload + delta-mode contract.

**Scope**:
- IN: Agent definition change to dso:story-decomposer (remediation_context input, DELTA OUTPUT template, Read gate, target_story_id filtering, backward-compat default)
- IN: Producer-side fixtures asserting DELTA OUTPUT declaration, evidence quotes, target_story_id filtering, backward-compat path
- OUT: Caller-side Phase E dispatch wiring (delivered by sibling story for SC1 caller wiring)
- OUT: DELTA OUTPUT template documentation in the shared protocol doc (delivered by SC4 shared-protocol story; this story references the token by name only)

## Done Definitions

- When dso:story-decomposer is invoked with a remediation_context payload of absolute file paths, its output begins with a DELTA OUTPUT mode declaration before any story draft
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When dso:story-decomposer is invoked with a remediation_context payload, its output contains a verbatim evidence quote from each reviewer-artifact path before the first story draft (pre-generation Read gate)
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When dso:story-decomposer is invoked with a remediation_context payload, stories whose target_story_id does not appear in any finding are absent from the output (no full re-decomposition)
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When dso:story-decomposer is invoked without a remediation_context payload, output shape is unchanged from current behavior (backward-compatible default)
  ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Reliability] The pre-generation Read gate must reference paths by absolute path; relative paths break under worktree-isolated sub-agent dispatch.
- [Contract] The DELTA OUTPUT mode declaration is a load-bearing string parsed by the caller — pick a stable token and document it in the agent's schema section.
- [Backward compatibility] Existing preplanning callers that do not pass remediation_context must see unchanged output; add the optional input without making it required.
- [Contract / Cross-producer reuse] The literal token "DELTA OUTPUT" and the surrounding template (mode declaration, evidence-quote block, target-id-scoped emission rules) will be reused verbatim by the sibling story for SC2's producers (approach-proposer + task-decomposer). The token + template MUST be documented in skills/shared/workflows/remediation-loop-protocol.md (SC4 shared-protocol story) once and referenced by drafts 1, 3, and 5; producer skill files MUST NOT redefine the template inline.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a preplanning orchestrator, I want dso:story-decomposer to accept a remediation_context and emit delta-only output gated by an evidence-quote Read step
